title: V3 C2 主题转弱确认 Shadow
primary_question: V3 股票腿 RISK_OFF_EXIT 是否能被大盘、行业、主题和卖后表现共同解释，哪些卖出疑似误杀？
primary_variable: read-only C2 shadow labels over V3 stock-leg risk-off exits
fixed_assumptions: stock_alpha_core risk-off exits only; ETF sleeve excluded
no runtime, NAV, signal, pool, ranking, execution, or exit-rule changes
theme health reused from C1 and matched as-of on or before exit date with 10-calendar-day limit

evidence.note: machine summary with window and verdict breakdowns

key_findings: Main window has 227 risk-off exits; theme evidence coverage is 58.1%.
Protected-profit exits count=56, pnl=4,953,274; these exits generally avoided later weakness.
Suspected theme-not-weak overkill count=25, pnl=2,740,892; these rebounded after risk-off exit.
Mixed industry-weak-but-rebounded count=35, pnl=-132,637; industry weakness alone is not enough for final confirmation.
C2 should stay as a diagnostic layer until C3 counterfactual proves delayed or staged exit is stable across windows.

decision.reason: Continue to C3 counterfactual; do not promote C2 directly to runtime because theme coverage and false-positive risk are still material.

next_actions: Run C3 delayed/staged exit counterfactual for suspected overkill samples only.
Separate results by profitable protected exits, losing exits, and rebounded exits.
Require cross-window stability before any formal AB.
